title: WHEN YOU NEED
GOD'S DIRECTION
end: The Guided Path — seek God's wisdom for every step

scenes.a: You stand unsure of the next right step.
When your own wisdom feels exhausted and every option looks blurred, hear the scripture:
Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; for therein do I delight.
Father, our feet stumble when we rely on our own understanding. Clear away the confusion today.
scenes.sub: LEAN NOT ON YOUR OWN MIND

scenes.a: Align our hearts with Your righteous way so we find true joy in following You.
Give us clarity for the decision right in front of us, and strength to step forward in faith.
Amen. You stand unsure of the next right step.
